note: Trust ring for signed rule updates: ed25519 public keys, hex-encoded. An empty ring means remote updates are closed (fail-closed) and the CLI uses only the baseline bundled in the package. Signing happens off-line, away from any server or pipeline, so a compromised control plane still cannot forge an update. Several keys may be valid at once; a client accepts a signature from any of them. k1 was retired on 2026-08-14: its private half had been living on an internet-facing server, which is exactly what the sentence above promises never happens. Nothing published was ever signed with it (the live bundle is k2), so retiring it breaks nothing.
